_comment: One spec sheet per element letter the parser accepts (spicelite.parser.ELEMENT_LETTERS). tests/test_element_sheets.py fails if a letter is missing or unknown. Values and defaults come from spicelite/circuit.py; units are SI.

r.name: Resistor
r.stamp: Conductance G = 1/R added between n1 and n2: +G on both diagonals, -G off the diagonal.

c.name: Capacitor
c.stamp: Admittance sC: open at DC, jωC in .ac, a companion conductance C/h (BE) or 2C/h (trap) plus a history current in .tran.

l.name: Inductor
l.stamp: An extra branch-current unknown with v(n1) - v(n2) - sL i = 0: a short at DC, jωL in .ac, a companion resistance in .tran.

v.name: Voltage source
v.syntax: V<name> n+ n- [DC] <v> [AC <mag> [<phase>]] [PULSE(v1 v2 td tr tf pw per) | SIN(vo va freq [td theta])]
v.stamp: An extra branch-current unknown and the row v(n+) - v(n-) = V; the current flows n+ through the source to n-.

i.name: Current source
i.stamp: Right-hand side only: I leaves n+ and enters n- (b[n+] -= I, b[n-] += I); no matrix entries.

d.name: Diode
d.syntax: D<name> anode cathode <model>   with   .model <model> D(IS=.. N=.. RS=..)
d.stamp: Shockley i = IS (e^(v/N Vt) - 1), linearised by Newton each iteration into a conductance g = di/dv and a current Ieq; RS adds a hidden internal node.

m.name: MOSFET, level 1
m.syntax: M<name> drain gate source bulk <model> [W=..] [L=..]   with   .model <model> NMOS|PMOS(LEVEL=1 VTO KP LAMBDA GAMMA PHI CGSO CGDO CGBO CBD CBS)
m.stamp: Shichman-Hodges drain current linearised by Newton into gm, gds and gmbs plus Ieq; the capacitances are added as hidden linear capacitors.
m.example: M1 out in 0 0 nm W=20u L=2u

e.name: Voltage-controlled voltage source (VCVS)
e.stamp: An extra branch-current unknown and the row v(n+) - v(n-) - gain (v(nc+) - v(nc-)) = 0. An op-amp is an E with gain 1e6.

g.name: Voltage-controlled current source (VCCS)
g.stamp: gm (v(nc+) - v(nc-)) flows n+ to n-: four matrix entries, no extra unknown.

f.name: Current-controlled current source (CCCS)
params: a V source whose current is sensed
f.stamp: gain times the branch current of Vsense flows n+ to n-: two entries in the Vsense current column.

h.name: Current-controlled voltage source (CCVS)
params: a V source whose current is sensed
h.stamp: An extra branch-current unknown and the row v(n+) - v(n-) - rm i(Vsense) = 0.
